disagreements.claim: Whether ETH ETF flows are strongly positive or have slowed
disagreements.verdict: NOT settled - $986.9M weekly appears in all three dossiers but Run 1 carries a contradicting 'slowed considerably' report and Run 3 a $48.2M Sep 3 outflow; no flow series retrievable this run. Resolved by assigning flows zero net drift rather than picking a side.

disagreements.claim: Whether any tradeable market anchors this contract
disagreements.verdict: Settled: none. Polymarket monthly/weekly are one-touch to Oct 1 on its own oracle; its dated dailies use Binance ETH/USDT at noon ET and end Sep 8; the only Kalshi figure is a stale Aug-26 month-end $2,650 that resolved wrong; Kalshi's live page returned HTTP 429 in two runs and remains unchecked.

disagreements.claim: Forward sigma - trailing realized ~2.2%/day (Runs 2,3) vs implied-plus-event ~2.6%/day (Run 1)
disagreements.verdict: Resolved toward the higher side (2.4%/day, 7.8% over the horizon): trailing realized cannot contain CPI Sep 11, the CLARITY vote Sep 15, or FOMC-with-dot-plot Sep 16, and the touch-implied read is consistent across five strikes and two separate markets.

disagreements.claim: Whether the $2,511-2,546 resistance band / $2,542 50-week MA justifies a discount below the lognormal number
disagreements.verdict: Only a small one. Three stalls at ~$2,510-2,515 is a real repeated observation, but the band sits 1.4% under the strike and a driftless walk already prices that distance; offset against the broken descending trendline and sustained inflows, net drift is zero, with ~1 point off for thin shoulders at 0.4 SD.

calls.reference_class: ETH 10-11 day forward moves needing >+3% held on one specific dated daily close, drawn from the current post-Aug-20 consolidation regime (daily SD ~2.2% realized, ~2.5-2.9% implied)
